title: 消えた灯と夏の影
description:
"See you in front of the goldfish scooping stall!"

On the night of the summer festival, Hotaru becomes separated from her best friend, Akari.

When she returns to their meeting place, Akari is nowhere to be found.

"Akari... where are you?"

The Vanished Light and the Summer ShadowA Japanese-style adventure game that uncovers the truth behind two girls.

Features■ A Japanese-Style Story Adventure Through the Four SeasonsExperience a story-driven adventure where exploration and conversations gradually reveal the truth.

■ Multiple Endings Shaped by Your ChoicesYour decisions and the places you explore will significantly change the course of the story.

Will you find hope—or be left with regret?

Discover your own ending.

■ A Nostalgic and Mysterious Japanese WorldExplore a quiet, nostalgic world with an unsettling atmosphere.

Uncover the memories of two girls as the story unfolds.

■ Created Almost Entirely by One PersonNearly every aspect of the game—including the scenario, artwork, and music—was created by a single developer.

■ Estimated Play TimeApproximately 2–3 hours.
description_short: Uncover the hidden truth behind a summer festival in this Japanese-style story adventure.
